_comment: Per-pipeline bids-filter inputs for the `select` stage. `anat_acquisition` is the canonical T1w acq label (SagMPRAGE; the legacy MPRAGEPromo is skipped at curation, see curation.py::SKIP_ACQUISITIONS). `tasks` mirrors the functional task set of curation.py::ACQUISITION_MAP (9 single + 11 dual). network_fmri shells `network-qa render bids-filter` with these to write code/bids-filter_<pipeline>.json. This filter is COARSE by design and is NOT how bad runs are kept out of preprocessing: a filter dict has no per-task run selectivity, so it cannot express a per-scan quality call. That job belongs to the `prune` stage, which deletes excluded scans and renumbers the survivors, leaving a tree that maps 1:1 onto the derivatives. The filters remain a declarative record of the intended task set.
